remarks: Experience city living at its finest in this updated sun-drenched 2 bedroom, 1 bath condo nestled in the vibrant heart of downtown Stamford. Located on the 3rd floor, this bright corner unit boasts an open-concept living and dining space, enhanced by oversized windows. The newly renovated eat in kitchen features quartz counters, stainless steel appliances, including a gas range and refrigerator, complemented by modern subway tile backsplash. There are two generously sized bedrooms offer ample closet space, and an updated full bathroom w/tub. Spanning 880 sq. ft., this unit also includes a private balcony overlooking Bedford St where you can take in sunrises and watching the fireworks! This secure-entry building has an inviting lobby area, and offers a range of amenities such as private rec room which can be reserved for parties, laundry facilities on main level, private storage locker, and a dedicated on-site superintendent. With easy access to the train station, I-95, and local shops, restaurants, and parks, this location is a commuter's dream. HOA fee covers heat, hot water, and cooking gas. Whether you're looking to owner occupy or purchase as an investment, this condo is a fantastic opportunity for all!
